title: Clean up Report Center copy: remove internal dev language and improve empty state messaging
goal: Audit all user-visible strings in ui/assets/modules/reports.js and ui/index.html for the Report Center screen. Remove or rewrite: (1) the screen-copy 'Work from the current run strip, open the report you need, and export without a side metadata rail.' — 'without a side metadata rail' is internal UI design language not useful to operators; rewrite to 'Review and export technical, executive, and compliance reports for the selected run.' (2) The 'Prior Report Delta' label and its instruction 'Select a baseline run to History & Compared to contrast report periods' — rewrite to be clearer: 'Compare with Earlier Run' with instruction 'Select a previous run to compare findings, coverage, and risk score changes.' (3) Any placeholder text visible in the report Reader panel when no report is selected — replace with a one-sentence empty state. (4) 'reportPlaceholder' function strings that are developer-facing descriptions.
scope: System review 2026-05-01: Report Center screen copy contains internal design language ('without a side metadata rail'), confusing labels ('Prior Report Delta', 'History & Compared'), and developer-facing placeholder text. Enterprise operators should see clear product copy at all times.
generation_reason: System review 2026-05-01: Report Center contains internal dev language in operator-visible copy — clean up for enterprise readiness.
